html:
The Battle of Vertieres, on 18 November 1803 near Cap-Francais, was the last major battle of the Haitian Revolution. The army of Jean-Jacques Dessalines defeated the French under Rochambeau.

Napoleon had sent a large army under his brother-in-law Leclerc in 1802 to restore French control and slavery. Leclerc tricked and deported Toussaint Louverture, but yellow fever and the fighting destroyed his army.

At Vertieres the officer Francois Capois led charges through French fire. Rochambeau surrendered days later and left the island. Six weeks later Dessalines declared independence. Haiti marks 18 November as a national day.
